targets.title: The slave trade and the origins of mistrust in Africa
targets.evidence_quote: In our narrow replication, using the code and dataset posted by the authors, as well as the same software (STATA 11), we could replicate all results reported in N&W. The remainder of this paper is concerned with the replication of N&W using the AB data from a later year, 2008.
targets.outcome_quote: In this replication exercise, we repeated the study of N&W on the persistent impact of historic slave exports on mistrust. Our narrow replication confirms their findings. Our scientific replication, which is based on an extended and more recent sample, also confirms the results of N&W.
